description: U.S. Census Block Groups is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. U.S. Census Block Groups This feature layer, utilizing National Geospatial Data Asset (NGDA) data from the U.S. Census Bureau (USCB), displays Census block groups in the 50 states, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico. Per the USCB, "Block Groups (BGs) are clusters of blocks within the same census tract. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Its keywords are block groups, tracts, boundaries, NGDA, National Geospatial Data Asset, FGDC, Federal Geospatial Data Committee, U.S. Census Bureau. The bounding box given is -179.2311,-14.6018,179.8597,71.4398. The hub shows 2026-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
